ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there is a benzene ring in the figure, and two hydroxyl groups are connected to the benzene ring: one is above, and the other is at the lower right; the two are in a meta relationship, indicating a resorcinol skeleton; several curved arrows are also drawn in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Below there is another nitrile fragment; on the left, R is connected to the nitrile carbon, and the nitrile carbon and nitrogen are triple-bonded; the nitrogen is then coordinatively connected to AlCl3, a positive charge is marked below the nitrogen, and a negative charge is marked at the aluminum-related position. Then reason: R is represented by * as an unknown substituent, so the nitrile fragment is *C#N; considering the N-to-AlCl3 coordination and the depicted formal charges, it is written as *C#[N+][Al-](Cl)(Cl)Cl. The two OH groups on the benzene ring are meta-dihydroxybenzene, which can be written as Oc1cccc(O)c1. The two parts are separated components in the figure, so they are connected with a dot.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First inspect the image and discard the curved electron-pushing arrows. Transcribe the lower fragment as an unspecified substituent R attached to nitrile carbon, giving *C#N, then include the N-to-AlCl3 coordination and formal charges shown below the atoms to obtain *C#[N+][Al-](Cl)(Cl)Cl. Next transcribe the aromatic ring as meta-dihydroxybenzene/resorcinol from the two OH substituents on the ring, using Oc1cccc(O)c1. Since the nitrile-AlCl3 fragment and the phenolic ring are drawn as separate components, join their SMILES with a dot, yielding *C#[N+][Al-](Cl)(Cl)Cl.Oc1cccc(O)c1.

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the diagram as containing a benzene ring with two hydroxyl substituents in a meta/resorcinol arrangement, plus a separate activated nitrile fragment labeled R–C≡N–AlCl3 with formal + on N and − on Al. Ignore all curved arrows as instructed.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the desired output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: aromatic benzene with meta dihydroxy substitution can be written as Oc1cccc(O)c1; an unspecified R group is represented by wildcard *; a nitrile C≡N is C#N; formal charges require bracket atoms [N+] and [Al-]; Al bonded to three chlorides is [Al-](Cl)(Cl)Cl; disconnected components are separated by a dot.
